messages:
jen_support: pushing this here — multiple customers (esp corp-acct-42) reporting intermittent 502/504 spikes and timeouts on /v1/generate since ~08:10 UTC. volume spike? or something else?
oliver_support: saw a support ticket with curl repro. user says requests hang ~8-12s then 502. sending logs.
jen_support: repro curl they used: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"summarize"}' -v
```
jen_support: attached truncated gateway logs (sensitive redacted) — repeated `upstream reset` and `connection closed` lines around 08:11-08:15.
ryan_sre: looking. initial suspicion: gateway conn-pool exhaustion on the edge-facing proxy. seeing a pattern of 100-200ms slow connect then upstream reset.
aisha_runtime: on the runtime side I see a small bump in KV cache evictions aligned with timestamps — several pods reported increased GC and OOM kill attempts earlier this morning (07:55-08:05). could be cascading backlog.
mike_pm: high-impact customer flagged via support tier 1. priority: mitigate customer impact (reduce 5xx), then triage root cause.
carla_sre: quick mitigation idea: enable temporary circuit-breaker + increase backend connection pool for gateway and enable request-level retries with jitter. can we flap deploy a config?
ryan_sre: agree. I can bump gateway pool limits and short-circuit requests to warm fallback model variant for affected routing key. prepping change.
jen_support: can we add more logging/tracing headers to correlate user requests end-to-end? customers want repro + timestamps.
aisha_runtime: yes — will add trace-id propagation and a minimal sampling span for problematic routes. will also add KV cache eviction metric to the tracing tags.
deploybot: deploy queued by ryan_sre: gateway/pool-config hotpatch -> env: prod -> rolling 50% -> ETA 5m
oliver_support: customer running at scale with 95th percentile token lengths ~512 — could be increasing concurrency pressure.
ryan_sre: rolled patch to half the gateways. monitoring now. early signs: backend connect error rate down 60% on patched nodes.
jen_support: customer confirmed fewer 502s in last 10m. partial mitigation looks good. they still see occasional single-request timeouts.
aisha_runtime: investigating runtime queueing — found one model-serving shard temporarily saturated due to uneven routing. adding short-lived traffic rebalancing and a fast-fail fallback to smaller model variant when queue depth > 200.
mike_pm: capture lessons and action items for postmortem: (1) expose queue-depth alert, (2) autoscaler tweak for shard imbalance, (3) clearer runbook for pool hotpatches, (4) improve e2e tracing for customer repro.
carla_sre: creating incident ticket and assigning action items. will schedule a postmortem meeting 9:30am PT.
jen_support: thanks team! I'll keep customer updated: communicated root-cause hypothesis (cache+pool+shard imbalance) and interim mitigations.
ryan_sre: final note — recommend we add short-term rate-limiter per-tenant to soften spikes and prevent backend conn-pool exhaustion. filing follow-up RFC. :+1:
